# Context essays (eras, places, themes)

Optional, secondary layer. These are long-form pieces about a topic (an era, a place, a theme) that cite and link to relevant books as further reading — they are not a substitute for the book entries themselves, and they should not restate a book's summary; link to it instead.

```yaml
title: ""
type: era | place | theme
perspectives: []   # required if the topic is politically or historically contested
```

## Perspectives panel — when required
If the topic has genuinely contested framings (e.g. the 1997 handover, the 2019 protests), the essay must include a `## Perspectives` section presenting the distinct viewpoints side by side, each labeled by its source tradition, rather than the essay adopting one narrative as neutral fact. This requires sign-off from at least two core reviewers before merge — see `EDITORIAL.md`.

If you're unsure whether a topic counts as contested, default to including the perspectives section — it's easier to remove during review than to retrofit.
